answer: Continuous retraining on live operational data exposes a machine learning system to poisoning attacks because an attacker may inject malicious samples into the data during operation. This adversarial contamination of the training data can disrupt or influence the retraining process, leading to a deterioration in the model's performance. As the model is retrained using potentially compromised data, it may learn from these poisoned inputs, which can result in unpredictable and harmful behaviors in the deployed system.
